description: This is a shell script that performs one-time setup tasks for deploying OpenClaw in a rootless Podman environment. It manages configurations, image builds or pulls, environment variables, and optional systemd service integration via Quadlet.

methods.name: require_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in PATH, outputs error and exits if not.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Determines if the current user has root privileges.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates the script.

methods.name: validate_single_line_value
methods.description: Ensures a string does not contain control characters.

methods.name: validate_absolute_path
methods.description: Checks if a path is absolute and well-formed.

methods.name: validate_mount_source_path
methods.description: Checks if a mount source path is valid and contains no colons.

methods.name: validate_container_name
methods.description: Validates container name syntax.

methods.name: validate_image_name
methods.description: Validates image name syntax and transport prefixes.

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_dir
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists and is safe (not a symlink).

methods.name: stat_uid
methods.description: Gets the UID of a file or directory.

methods.name: stat_mode
methods.description: Gets the permission mode of a file or directory.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_dir_owned_by_user
methods.description: Verifies directory ownership and permissions.

methods.name: ensure_safe_write_file_path
methods.description: Ensures that a file path can be safely written to.

methods.name: write_file_atomically
methods.description: Writes content to a file atomically with proper permissions.

methods.name: validate_port
methods.description: Checks port number validity (numeric, in range).

methods.name: escape_sed_replacement_pipe_delim
methods.description: Escapes special characters for sed replacement strings.

methods.name: resolve_user_home
methods.description: Resolves the home directory for a given user.

methods.name: generate_token_hex_32
methods.description: Generates a 32-byte hex token using available tools.

methods.name: seed_local_control_ui_origins
methods.description: Seeds the gateway control UI config with local allowed origins.

methods.name: upsert_env_var
methods.description: Inserts or updates an environment variable in a file.
